summary: Kerb where a line of cars already parks, with homes 25 m or more away.
reasons: Row of cars parked along kerb

best_section.where: Hawken Drive west kerb, in the middle of the parked-car row, before the red-roofed house

drivers.seclusion: Nearest mapped homes are 26 m and 37 m from this section, set back behind bush and the neighbouring plots.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide kerbside lane with many cars parked in Esri; room for a van to stand in line.
drivers.traffic: Through road with a steady flow, but cars park along the kerb so a van blends in.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this side. Only sign is a bus zone near the far end.

flags: Bus zone sign on the stretch, check position on site
Homes 7-10 m away at 0-15 m and 52-58 m, avoid those ends
sun_shade: Partial tree shade from the west side; open to the east.
